column1: # The three flaws planted in flawed-plan.md. The reviewers are not given this file.
# Tab-separated columns: id, anchor, subject, problem, description.
#   anchor   a phrase that must still be in flawed-plan.md (lower case). If it is gone, the flaw is no longer planted.
#   subject  extended regular expression: words for the subject of the flaw. Matched at the start of a word.
#   problem  extended regular expression: words that say something is wrong. Matched as whole words.
# A flaw counts as found when one lower-cased line of review text matches both subject and problem.
# A line that only names the subject does not count. flawed-plan.md itself must score 0.
